<thought>Using the Doebner Modification retrosynthetic template (mapped_rxn shows conversion of a cinnamic acid side‑chain to an aromatic aldehyde plus malonic acid), the target molecule “CC(C)(C)OC(=O)Nc1ccccc1NS(=O)(=O)Cc2ccc(C=CC(=O)O)cc2” is split by replacing the C=CC(=O)O group with a C=O aldehyde. This yields the aromatic aldehyde precursor “CC(C)(C)OC(=O)Nc1ccccc1NS(=O)(=O)Cc2ccc(C=O)cc2” and the other precursor is malonic acid “O=C(O)C(=O)O”. No alternative combinations are generated by this template.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"CC(C)(C)OC(=O)Nc1ccccc1NS(=O)(=O)Cc2ccc(C=O)cc2\", \"O=C(O)C(=O)O\"]]</final_answer>
